episode_boundary_candidate: one complete 24 s commanded trial after independently approved start acknowledgement through confirmed completion
missing_data_rule: never zero-fill or silently impute; missing remains null with reason; endpoint unavailable if future frozen gate fails

provisional_mathematical_definition.sign: signed F_task retained; RMS itself is sign-invariant; no arbitrary abs preprocessing
provisional_mathematical_definition.time_weighted_rms: J_force = sqrt(sum_i w_i F_task(t_i)^2 / sum_i w_i) over valid mask M
provisional_mathematical_definition.weight_definition: w_i is valid represented time on the frozen master grid; exact quadrature/interpolation rule pending timing validation

valid_sample_mask_requires: not within an excluded interval if a transient policy is later frozen
